# Study Tips for Exam Prep

## **Plan & Organize**
- Start early—don't cram at the last minute
- Break material into manageable chunks
- Create a study schedule spreading topics over weeks
- Identify what you find most challenging

## **Active Learning Methods**
- **Practice problems** – especially important for math/science
- **Flashcards** – great for memorization
- **Summarize** – rewrite notes in your own words
- **Teach others** – explaining concepts deepens understanding
- **Practice tests** – simulate exam conditions

## **Study Environment**
- Find a quiet, distraction-free space
- Turn off phone notifications
- Have materials ready before starting
- Take short breaks (5-10 min per hour)

## **Before the Exam**
- Review main concepts the night before
- Get good sleep
- Eat breakfast
- Arrive early to settle in

## **During the Exam**
- Read questions carefully
- Manage your time—don't spend too long on one question
- Answer easier questions first
- Review your answers if time allows

## **Tips by Subject**
- **Math/Science**: Do problems repeatedly
- **Languages**: Practice speaking/writing
- **History/Literature**: Create timelines or outlines
- **Essays**: Practice writing under time pressure

**What subject are you studying?** I can give more specific advice!
